message.content:
Based on the image provided, here are the answers to your questions:

1.  **Screen Title:** The title at the top of the container window is **"Chest"**.
2.  **Left Side Slot:** **No**, there is no single slot on the left side. The screen displays a standard grid of inventory slots without a separate equipment or crafting slot on the left (unlike a furnace or anvil interface).
3.  **Grid Columns:** The item grid has **9 columns**.
4.  **First Grid Item:** **Yes**, there is an item in the top-left slot of the grid. It looks like a grey **cobblestone block**.
